Rather fun gameplay with a small but fair variety of weapons and combat styles to keep you entertained. The story is subpar and barely a factor as this is much more focused on the experience of combat. If you can't tell this is between a God of War and a Diablo combo but without the level of depth those Ips have. The visuals are quite lovely as is the sound design despite some curious casting choices. This game is fun if you just want to explore and murder monsters and men in violent fun ways but if you are looking for a deep story or revolutionary mechanics I wouldn't look here. This is a great game if you get it for less than ten dollars.

It is so close to being a great game, but for me it just isn't there. The combat amounts to holding down a button and aiming your character at swarms of weak enemies. Combat is an inconvenience in this game. The exploration was pretty fun, but the characters are pretty bad and so is the dialogue. Meh story. I wish it wasn't true but for me, I wish I hadn't wasted my money on it. Skip it if you value combat and storytelling.

Fun little Metroidvania with a crafting element!  Difficulty isn't too punishing, so should be enjoyable for a more casual gamer, while still presenting enough challenge for more serious plaftform fans.  Not especially long play-time, but satisfying.

This game has great graphics, the world design and story is all top notch. The core gameplay is like the uncanny valley of soulslike games however, they're close enough so your brain thinks its a soulslike game but they just havent hit the mark. The amount of times you will die due to weird camera glitches or your lock on just randomly disengaging or because you fairly dodged the trajectory of an attack only for the enemy to magnetise to your new location mid swing is more frustrating than the positive aspects of the game can redeem unfortunately, really wanted to like this game and was so hyped after playing the beta :( Inb4 "get good" a good soulslike game can kill you literally 100s of times without you feeling unfair if the mechanics are tight

Good story with choices that make a difference to the outcome. 
Gameplay can be difficult at times especially at the end with limited resources, but not so bad it makes you want to quit.  Level design was fun and interesting, especially the zero-G sections.  The worldbuilding was really good and the station felt lived in and realistic.

Game performed well on my laptop which isn't anything special in terms of GPU or specs. 

Not my favorite game by any stretch, but I enjoyed it and would recommend it if you are a fan of games like Bioshiock.

Hello my friends :)
As always, I'm very pleasantly surprised by the game's performance on the Steam Deck and Steam Machine :)
On the Steam Deck, it averages between 30-40 fps with all settings on low and FSR on ultra performance. However, there are still occasional significant fps drops and frame drops. :/

On the Steam Machine, it runs with ultra settings, FSR quality, and ray tracing on at 50-65 fps, not bad :) All in 1080p.

Have had a real blast in VR mode with this game (Oculus Quest 3, streaming via Virtual Desktop). It's now hard for me to think about playing a game like this without VR because the experience is much more intense.

 It was essential for me to combine Puredarks AFW mod with the RE9VR mod (from Nexusmods) for some of the puzzles and inventory items to show correctly. AFW also improved the smoothness of gameplay. The experience was excellent after combining these two, the instructions about AFW are found on RE9VR mod page and Grok AI was very helpful when I had something to ask about the installation process (unlike Gemini). Make sure to follow AFW's instructions regarding graphical settings, these make a critical difference to the experience..

Overall fantastic game. Less metroidvania than hollow knight with less exploration but much better combat. Movement and exploration are good but not great. The story is the best of any metroidvania on the market, without a doubt.
